content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00019, SRS_Rte_00033 An RteEventToTaskMapping shall only own more than one RteEventRef refer- ence if all owned RteEventRef s refer to OperationInvokedEvent s which in turn are triggering the same server ExecutableEntity .
